context: Goro-grandpa and Hiroshi-elder catch up at a small soba shop.
purpose: Two elder men sharing simple comfort food.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: It's been a long time since I've had soba.
lines.style: Soft opening, almost sighing the recognition. Warm, nostalgic tone. Unhurried pace. Let the moment settle — this is comfort returning, not surprise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ここの汁、ほんま美味しい。
lines.en: The broth here really is something special.
lines.style: Pause before speaking, like gathering the words. Kansai drawl on the affirmation. Slow reverent pace. Gentle appreciation — he's tasting memory, not just food.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 年取っても、この味は変わらん。
lines.en: No matter how much time passes, this flavour never changes.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to himself. A light philosophical weight — not heavy, but true. Steady, measured pace. Slight warmth underneath the observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Brief, genuine agreement. Kansai lilt on the closing. Warm and humble, not performative. The kind of 'yeah' that says 'I know exactly what you mean.'

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Soft, easy suggestion without pressure. Warm tone — offering something good to share. Light, natural pace. Trailing off slightly, like the idea lingers.
